name: Decentralized Intelligence
steps: Open di.xyz/check-in and check the address bar. Use a wallet that holds only a little BNB.
Press Connect & sign in and choose your wallet. "First login requires a free signature. No gas or asset transfer."
Switch the wallet to BNB Chain and keep some BNB in it. Without it the page answers: "Add enough BNB to cover network gas, then try again."
Come back on 30 days in total. A wallet that starts on 18 November 2026 reaches 30 on 17 December at the earliest.

For extra points, link your X account in the Task Center ("Link an X account before starting X tasks."), follow DI, join the Telegram group and do the daily tasks that are open. If the X link fails, the page's advice is "Avoid in-app browsers and VPNs."
Keep an eye on DI's X account for the Genesis NFT mint. Its date, price and rules aren't published.
what: No DI airdrop is confirmed. 30 daily check-ins on BNB Chain count toward a whitelist for its 2,000 Genesis NFTs, plus points. Steps, costs and risks.
behind: The site and whitepaper carry the name Decentralized Intelligence LTD, with no country or registration number. No founder or chief executive is named. The chief operating officer posts on X under the name Goldchau and hasn't published a real name. costs: DI takes no fee. The first sign-in is a free signature, and each check-in is a BNB Chain transaction that carries no value, so the cost is network gas: a small amount per day, 30 times over to reach the milestone, paid in BNB.
